question.text: A liquid of density <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>750</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kg</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup></math> flows smoothly through a horizontal pipe that tapers in cross-sectional area from <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></math> to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mfrac><msub><mi>A</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mn>2</mn></mfrac></math>. The pressure difference between the wide and narrow sections of the pipe is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4500</mn><mo> </mo><mi>Pa</mi></math>. The rate of flow of liquid is _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></mrow><mn>3</mn></msup><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>.

solution.text:
From the equation of continuity, v2=2v1.

Applying the Bernoulli's Theorem,

P1+ρv122=P2+ρ4v122  ⇒P1-P2=3ρv122

⇒4500=3×750×v122  ⇒v1=2 m s-1

Now volume flow rate,Q=Av1=1.2×10-2×2=24×10-3 m3 s-1
